concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-marketplaces-reconciliation-use-cases-reconcile-transfers]] — 2026-09-15 Marketplace Accounting Report guide for internal versus bank transfer categories, Transfer/Transaction ID booking, signed two-sided rows, references and Statement alternative; no bank-receipt proof.
warnings: The worked internal transfer has distinct Transfer Ids per balance-account leg but a shared booked Transaction Id (raw lines 50–55); do not assume one Transfer Id across both sides.
Booked bankTransfer report rows are platform-side accounting, not independent beneficiary-bank receipt.
